title: Fondamantal — Music Library
label: Streaming Interface / Media System
summary: A brand-owned listening experience built for discovery, clarity, and fast playback without third-party embed constraints.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: The Music Library is the core listening experience within the Fondamantal platform—built as a first-class product feature rather than an external embed.

sections.title: The Problem
sections.body: Third-party players limit branding, introduce distractions, and reduce control over navigation and performance.

sections.title: The Solution
sections.body: A custom library focused on clear track organization, predictable playback behavior, minimal UI noise, and seamless integration with the platform.

sections.title: Key Features
bullets: Clean track listing built for scanning and quick playback
Brand-consistent player UI aligned with the platform

sections.title: Outcome
sections.body: A cohesive, controlled listening environment that strengthens brand ownership and sets a foundation for deeper audience features.

sections.title: Key Takeaway
sections.body: Owning the playback layer improves branding, performance, and long-term flexibility.

cta.headline: Planning a custom media experience?
cta.body: If your platform requires audio, video, or content delivery beyond embeds, I can help structure a system that scales.
